documentation_validation.historical_reference_scope: Parent-plan source excerpts may refer to archived predecessor or external Rust checkout; these are provenance, not current Python implementation anchors.

limitations: All acceptance results are local Linux x86-64 CPython 3.11.7. No macOS arm64, CPython 3.14, isolated hash-locked dependency matrix or constrained release host was executed.

The private worker stage is a bounded identity sort over memory batches. Production mix, verification and recovery do not construct the scheduler; no production process parallelism or speedup is claimed.

Derived-key segment capabilities, protected task ownership pages, disk-credit handoffs, external result authentication, MemoryRef/TransferReceipt APIs, worker-local subleases and encrypted auto-spill transfers remain missing.
READY growth that cannot fit currently stops/reaps the private scheduler. Rebuilding a lower-concurrency partition and retrying startup remains missing.
Child/helper baselines, row metadata, channel copies and job-workspace coefficients have local admission tests but no Plan 16 resource-envelope calibration.
The interpreter-owned POSIX resource-tracker helper is observed and reserved during invocation; it may persist afterward and is not a task worker terminated by the scheduler.

The launch lock serializes ReadMixer environment changes only; unrelated concurrent application os.environ mutation is not isolated. Concurrent ReadMixer launch acceptance and supported native-build matrices remain open.

Shutdown escalation cases use bounded shorter test deadlines while asserting production 10/5/5-second constants. These do not qualify real coordinator SIGINT/SIGTERM at all public workflow/publication stages.
The independent serial six-artifact oracle uses bounded 14-pair unrefined fixtures. Forced refinement/collisions have separate component oracles; process scheduling/platform equivalence remains open.
The supplied-data workflow consumes only 128 pairs per sample. The complete 30,042,389-pair private dataset has not been mixed, fully verified and recovered through both modes.

The tiny benchmark is correctness/startup/tooling evidence, not representative throughput, process-stage performance, full I/O/backpressure accounting or greater-than-four-times-admitted-RAM qualification.
Historical evidence and dev2/dev3/dev4 archive hashes remain attached to their original candidates.
